title: Farm Land
description: Tired of the four old stinky vanilla crops in Minecraft? Install this mod to get some more!
body:
# The farming overhaul that we need but still don't have

This mod adds the following new crops to Minecraft:

- Tomato
- Bell Pepper
- Onion
- Eggplant
 

You will find some new wild plants while exploring the overworld.

To grow the new crops included in this mod, you have to destroy them and take the seeds from the vegetable.

Stay tuned for updates, and please download it even if you aren't going to use it. It helps a lot :)


If there is any issue, let me know about it at [the issue tab in CurseForge](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/farm-land/issues)

Planned features:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- CUCUMBER
- LETTUCE

</details>

- New foods with the new veggies.
- More crops, but not too many (less than 10 in total).
- Villages with farms growing these crops (far future).

_I'LL UPDATE THE MOD AFTER THE MCREATOR UPDATE FOR MINECRAFT 26.1 SUPPORT_
